title: The Ghost Seen By The Shield Hero
paragraphs: “Oh my?”
“W-What is it? Is it a difficult conversation after a fight between heroes?”
The older sister and the panda were looking back and forth between us.
“Even if you tell them after exposing the conspiracy, will that help?”
“N-No, it’s impossible. The timing of when she was taken is different.”
“But even if you try to warn them, saying, ‘Your daughter will be taken as collateral for a debt,’ would that change anything?”
Itsuki fell silent.
“If you try to warn them carelessly, they’ll get suspicious. Motoyasu-kun’s story has no proof. Would an ordinary person believe that?”
“No way. I wouldn’t believe it either.”
“Amaki-dono… well, I was the same. It’s a difficult situation.”
“But if you try to recruit her as a hero, would that Rishia-san even come? Would she really devote herself to Itsuki so earnestly?”
“Considering that, maybe things are still better as they are now. Even if she’s been defiled, she still has a kind man who cares for her, and he’s a hero.”
“I-I see… but if I remember the exact date when she was taken, I should be able to go save her.”
“The Itsuki of that time would probably feel guilty about it, though.”
When Ren said that, Itsuki recoiled slightly and slumped down.
“Understood… I’ll admit defeat. But Motoyasu-san, I’ll tell you the exact date, so please give me a push to save Rishia-san when the time comes.”
“Father already warned me. Understood.”
“Haah… how did it come to this?”
“Blaming everything on Motoyasu-kun… is actually difficult. You know, because of the timeline and all.”
“Being a hero involves some complicated discussions, huh?”
“Indeed. But I’m a little curious.”
And so, after the conversation, everyone went about their tasks for the day.
It was around noon. Father, looking pale, came to us while we were having lunch. Éclair, the older sister, and the panda were off doing their own thing.
“Everyone! I saw a ghost!”
He looked incredibly tense. A ghost, now?
“A ghost… Naofumi-san, do you not remember how many times we’ve fought ghosts, spirits, and evil apparitions before?”
“That’s not it! It’s just… someone asked me for help, and when I looked away for a moment, they disappeared!”
“If they need help, whether it’s Faubrey or Melromarc, wouldn’t following the proper procedures be enough?”
“Exactly. Or maybe it’s one of those treacherous women who always hang around the transferred ones?”
“She did have a somewhat alluring atmosphere, but she didn’t seem like the type to betray others!”
That description reminds me of the Crimson Swine buried deep in my memories. But since Father said so, there must be some difference.
“How was she different?”

“Hmm. It’s hard to explain, but… she really looked like she was in trouble. She was saying something about not being able to fulfill her mission, or asking for a special favor… and then the gem on the shield started glowing.”
The gem on the shield glowed? I looked at the gem embedded in the center of Father’s shield. If the hero’s weapon reacted, there might be something going on.
“If the gem is glowing, that might mean something.”
“It could be an enemy trap. Don’t let your guard down.”
“I know that, but still!”
Father looked toward me.
“Motoyasu-kun, do you know anything about this?”

Since it’s a question from Father, I’ll think deeply about it. First, I don’t have anyone in mind who fits that description. Maybe the Father from the first world would know, but I certainly don’t. Is something supposed to happen around this time?

Well, this is about when the revitalization of Cal Mira Island ends, so it’s around the time when we, in the first world, started our foolish barbaric acts. There were so many incidents around this period that my memory is a bit fuzzy. Even in the previous loop, it was around the time when Ren and Itsuki revived the Spirit Tortoise, so I probably wouldn’t have paid attention even if a ghost showed up.
“I don’t know.”
“See? Even Motoyasu-san, with his loop knowledge, doesn’t know. This must be happening for the first time.”
“Hmm… maybe it was just my imagination?”
“If it bothers you that much, why not borrow a loupe from Rat-san?”
“Good idea. I’ve been avoiding it because seeing ghosts is just too creepy, but maybe I should borrow it.”
“If Motoyasu gets better at handling his Soul Eater weapon, wouldn’t he be able to see without the loupe?”
“I can see them, you know?”

After experimenting a lot with the Soul Eater Spear to see what it could do, I discovered that I could see souls. It must be the true essence of the Soul Eat special effect. The depths of the legendary weapons are truly profound.
“To us, it’s more like a Soul Vacuum, right?”
“By the way, when did the Soul Eater first appear from the waves?”
“The second wave in Melromarc. That was about a month ago, timing-wise.”
Father and the others looked at me slowly, with a slightly exasperated expression.
“Uh… wasn’t it Queen Melromarc who resolved that incident?”
“That’s what was said. So, it must have appeared around that time.”
“I participated in that event during the last loop. I captured Itsuki alive.”
“I was being used by the princess back then, wasn’t I? If I was captured alive… what kind of torture did Motoyasu-san put me through?”
Calling it torture is rude. All I did was pour water on him and forcibly shove food into his mouth.
“I captured him so that his comrades wouldn’t kill him.”
“And what is someone who abandoned Rishia saying…?”
“Itsuki, I get that you’re still holding onto that, but you’re getting off track.”
“It seemed like there was no one decent besides Rishia… Well, I understand how he feels, though.”

“I captured Itsuki, and when he said, ‘I won’t accept charity from evil,’ about the food Father specially prepared, I just forcefully shoved it into his mouth. Since he was being noisy, I put him to sleep with Sleep Spear.”
“Imprisonment and torture, huh… I can vividly imagine the suffering of the previous Itsuki.”
“I’m still suffering plenty now!”
Itsuki still seems to be holding a grudge over Stalker Pig. I can’t understand stalkers at all!
“But Rishia-san looked healthier than I expected. I was surprised too.”
“I know that both Motoyasu-san and I are to blame… but that’s the only saving grace.”
“I hope she keeps getting better.”
“Yeah…”
“Back to the topic, Itsuki was being used by that princess, the king, and the Three Heroes Church, right? There was even a revolution, I think.”

“When you think about it, it’s terrifying. Pretending to be righteous while indulging in evil… It’s hard to tell what’s right anymore. But even amidst that, saving someone like Rishia-san who was in trouble… True justice is really difficult.”
Itsuki looked as if he was horrified and nodded repeatedly. Of course. The previous Itsuki was really annoying.
“Actually, I think there were some big issues with Motoyasu-kun taking him alive too.”

“But the Three Heroes Church tried to kill Fiancée right in front of Father, and on top of that, they fabricated charges of abduction. Itsuki put on his righteous act and wouldn’t listen to a word I said.”
“Self-inflicted consequences… I guess. But I wish my past self had listened to the other side a little more.”
“Anyway, because of Father’s overly high reputation, not only did a revolution break out, but the Siltvelt army came charging in, and things got chaotic.”
“Was that when the loop happened?”
“No, that was when Father stood in front of the Siltvelt army to protect Melromarc and negotiated.”
“…When you look at his actions, Naofumi-san always acts like a hero, doesn’t he?”
“In reality, he’s just a lucky, overly caring otaku.”
“W-Why am I getting looked down on here?”
“Well, it’s Motoyasu-san’s testimony, so it’s no surprise that Naofumi-san sounds like a shining figure.”
“If I recall, back then, I fled to Zeltoble and came back acting all heroic with the allied forces led by the Queen.”
That was mostly correct, so I nodded. Well, Ren did his part in his own way, I suppose? Though for some reason, Ren seems to have a low opinion of himself this time.
“Riding the winning horse, huh? On the other hand, Itsuki had it pretty rough.”
“Probably.”
“He was always looking to nitpick something. Acting like he was completely innocent.”
Itsuki had a bitter expression on his face. Well, from my perspective, it’s something I witnessed firsthand, but from Itsuki’s point of view, it must feel like baseless accusations.
